item.title: Anime Shop Simulator ✨
item.description:
Title: Anime Shop Simulator ✨
Genre: Action , Adventure , Casual , Massively Multiplayer , RPG , Simulation , Sports
Developer: One More Time
Publisher: One More Time , Polnoch
Release Date: Sep 11, 2026




About This Game

Anime Shop Simulator is fun first-person simulation where you become the manager of your very own anime shop!

Play solo or join forces with friends in online co-op to expand your shop, attract more customers, and create the ultimate otaku and trading card paradise!

MANAGE YOUR SHOP

Build your dream Anime Shop! Arrange manga, figures, and collectible cards on the shelves to create a seamless and enjoyable shopping experience for your customers.

CO-OP GAMEPLAY

Join forces with your friends online in 4-player co-op mode to manage your anime shop together, divide responsibilities, and plan strategies to maximize your profits.

COLLECT THEM ALL AND FIGHT IN PVP!

Unbox booster packs and discover unique treasures! Find rare collectible cards to sell for a profit or keep them to complete your ultimate anime card collection. Fight with other players in PvP TCG game and find out who's the best!

CUSTOMIZATION

Transform your anime store into a one-of-a-kind otaku haven! Choose your favorite wallpaper, give your shop a unique name, and decorate it with items to reflect your personal style.

GROW

Enlarge your shop, upgrade its decor, and stay in tune with the dynamic trends of the anime industry to remain competitive.

In Anime Shop Simulator your decisions shape your journey. Can you transform your small boutique into a thriving otaku hub while balancing customer satisfaction and financial success?

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i3 3.0 GHz or Ryzen 3xxx
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 960 4GB VRAM
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 3 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

item.title: The Loopler
item.description:
Title: The Loopler
Genre: Casual , Indie , Racing , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: Mheep
Publisher: Mheep , Zero Percent
Franchise: Zero Percent
Release Date: Sep 11, 2026




About This Game

The Loopler is a roguelite deckbuilder about a slot car driving in mesmerizing loops. Pick cards, place gates, and collect charms. Settle into the loop as numbers go up and dopamine fills your brain. See how far you can go in the pursuit of infinity.



  • Big Variety: With a heap of different game-changing cards, create synergies and manipulate the ways you reach the goal. Will you go for big scores or will you chase insane speeds?

  • Draft your build: Pick your cards, discover synergies, and put together a winning build. Watch the cards jump as they trigger from many different sources.

  • Unique Effects: Cards can give you a bunch of different effects: from increasing passive multipliers, to spawning ghost cars, to rolling the dice for a jackpot, to triggering other cards altogether.

  • Gate Madness: Place gates on the track to enable even more synergies and enhance the craziness that unfolds.

  • Optimise Placement: Each track comes with a number of gate placement slots. Figure out the best combo order of gates to get the most out of each gate.

  • Chain Reaction: Trigger a chain of reaction of passive multipliers, unique effects, and compounding synergies that turn a normal run into a fireworks show.

  • Collect Charms: Discover and stack powerful passive Charms, which further change how your run plays out.

  • Zero to Hero: Tip the scales from a modest drive into a screen tearing powerhouse of dopamine.

  • Unleash full potential: Synergize your build between cards, gates, and charms to unlock the true ecstasy of The Loopler

Push the car beyond its limits. Fine-tune each aspect of your build, max out your cards and gates, and assemble the god run to see if you can reach infinity. Prepare for the challenge accordingly, you will need it.

9 Cars, each with their own identity and effects

9 Tracks with different looks and layouts to fully challenge your build

5 difficulty modes to make it even harder to go infinite

Daily and weekly challenges, with a variety of optional leaderboards

50 Cards to draft

30 Gates to place

70 Charms to collect

Chill soundtrack by Pulsewith (Justin Skomarovsky)

Infinity awaits

item.title: The Crust
item.description:
Title: The Crust
Genre: Simulation , Strategy
Developer: VEOM Studio
Publisher: Crytivo
Franchise: The Crust
Release Date: Sep 10, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Jul 15, 2024




About This Game

1.0 OUT NOW — full campaign with multiple endings, Planning Mode, Sandbox 2.0, global events, macOS

Mine resources and automate their production processes

Mine lunar resources, craft processing machinery, and power up your base with satellites and batteries. Unlock scientific advancements across three research trees to enhance your technological capabilities.

Automate resources with conveyor belts and drones.

Streamline your resource management as you deploy conveyor belts and drones for seamless automation

Explore

Embark on lunar expeditions to unearth the moon's hidden secrets, deploying your rover to various locations and delving into the mysteries of humanity's newfound lunar habitat.

Trade Resources

Engage in resource exchange with Earth through contracts, where your decisions have the power to shape their political landscape. Choose a faction to support or navigate the field strategically for maximum profit.

Assemble a team of colonists

People are your most valuable resource. Keep track of your colonists' health, mood and needs. Hire the best experts and make sure they work as a team: it’s their unique traits and skills that will allow you to truly optimize your production and research!

Key Features

  • Build a lunar colony

  • Mine and automate resources and production

  • Explore the moon

  • Play through a rich, story driven narrative

  • Trade with Earth

  • Influence politics

  • Manage colonists and their needs

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

All voice acting is performed by professional actors and is licensed.

All the music in the game was composed by real composers—Ilya Khaminov, Sergey Sergeev, Alexander Kosyakov, and Emil Zenko—and is licensed.

All 3D models and animations were created by our talented team of professional artists.

As part of the development process, generative AI was used to assist in the creation of certain visual elements, including artistic textures and company logos. The AI-generated content was reviewed, edited, and/or further refined by our development team before being incorporated into the game.

The game has been in development since 2019, and 99% of all game content was created by professional developers, artists, and designers.



System Requirements

Windows

* Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.

MacOS

item.title: Gunman Contracts - Stand Alone
item.description:
Title: Gunman Contracts - Stand Alone
Genre: Action , Indie , Early Access
Developer: ANB_Seth
Publisher: 2080 Games
Release Date: Sep 10, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 10, 2026




About This Game

"Gunman Contracts – Stand Alone" is an intense, action-movie-inspired single player shooter created from the ground up for VR and Non-VR. Take on the role of “the gunman”, a professional operative feared in the criminal underworld, working for an illusive order vowed to deliver justice in a world beyond the reach of the law - one contract at a time.

From solo developer ANB_Seth, creator of the popular Half-Life: Alyx mods "Gunman Contracts – Chapter 1 & Chapter 2" , this game takes the action to the next level with a completely new, from-the-ground-up developed single-player experience.

STORY CAMPAIGN

The Gunman sets his sights on a new target: The Collectors - a ruthless crime operation killing and kidnapping innocent people for reasons yet unknown. Pick out your gear, take aim and get ready to kill your way to the dark truth behind the collectors operation. From an old Safehouse outside the city, to a warehouse district and a mob run restaurant with a dark truth kept below.

TRAIN IN "THE HIVE" - THE GUNMAN'S BASE

The gunman's base features a speed-shooting obstacle course, pop up target practice, a classic gun range, and holographic combat training. Your gun wall has 18+ weapons to unlock and a gun bench to make them your own.

CHALLENGE MODES AND LEADERBOARDS

In the Takedown-Mode you can select Enemy types, Enemy count and then clear the area. In Last Stand, survive an endless wave of hostiles and disarm bombs as long as you can. Feeling competitive, or just out for a personal best? Every contract, challenge and skill game features steam leaderboards (divided up between VR and Non-VR).

EARLY ACCESS

The game launches in Early Access with a set of 3 full story missions and challenge maps, with 3 additional story missions to be added with free future updates. However, the price of the game is set to increase as more contracts and content are added up to version 1.0. So feel free to join the party early!

LAUNCH PACKAGE

The game will release with the following content, with more (free) updates to come in the future:

  • 3 Connected Story Contracts

    - Safehouse in the city outskirts

    - Syndicate run harbor warehouse district

    - Mobster restaurant with a dark underbelly

  • The “Hive” (The Gunman's Home Base)

    - Gunwall to store and unlock weapons

    - Gun bench to skin weapons and modify gun sounds

    - Gun range with skill games and training stations

    - Holographic enemy combat area

  • Challenge Game Modes (5 Maps Available)

    - Takedown Mode: Face off against up to 30 enemies to kill in a closed area

    - Last Stand Mode: Fight against waves of enemies, disarm bombs and survive as long as you can

  • 18 Weapons To Unlock with per-weapon attachments

  • Compound Bow and Knives

  • Custom Music Feature play your own mp3 files in-game via the Gunman’s smartphone

  • Steam Achievements

  • Steam Leaderboards for every contract, skillgame and challenge

  • Unlockable Cheats

  • Optional Low-Violence Mode

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Modeld after gun blazing hollywood action thrillers, this game contains content not appropriate for all ages, and may not be appropriate for viewing at work, featuring frequent violence and general mature content.

Note: this game can also be played in a "low violence" mode, which disables nearly all blood effects and splatter, but still keeps the action intact.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
    • Processor: Non-VR: Intel Core i5-7500 or better
    • Memory: 12 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Non-VR: GTX 1070 or better
    • Storage: 20 GB available space
    • VR Support: OpenXR: Standing / Sitting
    • Additional Notes: Tests on various systems are still in progress. These Specs are for Non-VR.
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
    • Processor: VR: Intel Core i7-12700 or better
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: VR: RTX 3060 or better
    • Storage: 20 GB available space
    • VR Support: OpenXR: Standing / Sitting
    • Additional Notes: Tests on various systems are still in progress. These Specs are for VR.

item.title: WARDOGS
item.description:
Title: WARDOGS
Genre: Action , Indie , Massively Multiplayer , Simulation , Early Access
Developer: BULKHEAD
Publisher: Team17
Franchise: WARDOGS , Team17
Release Date: Sep 10, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 10, 2026




About This Game

WARDOGS is an All-Out Warfare FPS that combines tactical gunplay and combined arms combat with building and destruction mechanics in a large-scale, up to 100-player militaristic sandbox.

The game mode - Inspired by ‘King of the Hill’ - has three teams fight for control of randomized 2x2km ‘Control Zones’ within larger maps. The team with the most players within the Control Zone earns points - the first team to reach 100 points wins the match. The variables in zone location and individual player tactics mean no match ever plays out the same.

In WARDOGS – Every. Decision. Matters.

Every player starts their journey with $10,000. Each life, you purchase a custom loadout from a wide selection of weapons, gear, utility, and vehicles to help your team win the match.

Every teamplay action you perform rewards cash. From reviving squadmates, transporting friendlies to the zone, or controlling the objective. We don’t just encourage teamplay; we reward it. It’s the player’s choice how they want to play, earn and spend their profits.

Cash persists from match to match, so spending big on better gear, equipment, or a vehicle at the right time has the potential to turn the tide of battle and could yield massive returns.

You Choose How You Want to Play & Profit.

There’s no one way to play, earn and progress. Instead, WARDOGS gives players the freedom to take on the Control Zone in any number of ways. Whether you’re a lone wolf helping out your team or part of a dedicated squad, how you approach the battlefield is entirely up to you.

You could chase the 'Hot Zone' to earn double the cash, purchase a ghillie suit and snipe from a distance, or ferry supplies to teammates by helicopter. Additionally, you could choose to fortify a strategic chokepoint by building your own forward operating base, or if you're feeling destructive... man an artillery tank and rain down destruction on the enemy.

There are no set rules of engagement. It’s ultimately your choice how you want to approach the battlefield.

Bring the Chaos to Tactical Warfare.
Destroy apartment blocks with rocket launchers or tear your way through towns in heavily armoured tanks. The world around you reacts to your presence. Conversely, strategize with your teammates to build upon and fortify key locations within the map for a tactical advantage.

Every Moment in WARDOGS is 100% Player Driven and tied together with local voice chat to either talk tactics with teammates or troll enemy players. This is not another ‘Battle Royale’. This is not another ‘Extraction Shooter’. WARDOGS is a new Tactical take on the All-Out Warfare FPS genre that rewards decision making, communication and teamwork – and allows you to play how you want within a modern militaristic setting.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Wardogs contains killing with weapons and melee combat.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel® Core i5 8600, AMD Ryzen 5 3500
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1660, Radeon RX 590
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 50 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: 1080p Low @ 60fps (Upscaled)
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11
    • Processor: Intel® Core i7 12700k, AMD Ryzen 7 5700x
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3070, AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 50 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: 1440p Medium @ 70fps+ (Native) or 4k Medium @ 60fps+ (Upscaled)
